user.title: Set up Tuya Irrigation
user.description: Click Submit to enable the Tuya Irrigation integration. It registers the `irrigation_by_seconds` and `irrigation_by_liters` services and auto-registers the Lovelace card bundle. There is nothing to configure here.

abort.already_configured: Tuya Irrigation is already set up.

irrigation_by_seconds.name: Seconds⏰💧 (🌱timed irrigation)
irrigation_by_seconds.description: Time: opens the valve, waits N seconds, then closes it. The timer runs server-side inside Home Assistant, so it works regardless of the valve firmware's own auto-off behaviour (useful for devices such as the Tuya _TZE200_a7sghmms whose native duration timer is unreliable under ZHA).

switch_entity.name: Valve
switch_entity.description: The switch entity that controls the irrigation valve.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to keep the valve open, in seconds.

irrigation_by_liters.name: Liters🪣💧 (🌱volume irrigation)
irrigation_by_liters.description: Volume: opens the valve, monitors the device's _summation_delivered sensor and closes the valve when the configured volume has been delivered. Two safety nets bound a run that never reaches its target: a stall watchdog closes the valve if no water is measured for ~5 minutes, and an adaptive cap tightens the maximum runtime toward the measured flow rate (never beyond the safety timeout below).

switch_entity.name: Valve
switch_entity.description: The switch entity that controls the irrigation valve.

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Target volume to deliver, in liters.

timeout_seconds.name: Safety timeout (max run time)
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time the valve may stay open before it is forcibly closed, whether or not the target volume is reached. The adaptive cap only tightens this downward — closing sooner when the sampled flow rate says the run should already be done — never later. A stalled flow still closes the valve within ~5 minutes regardless. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).
